dimensions.basis: A charter is stated, but actual stop authority is not evidenced.
Retained ergonomist and trained fit champions are allocated.

Approval of risk review and incident/withdrawal arrangements is unknown, not proven absent.
Voluntary worker participation and no quota increase are explicit.
Daily operational and maintenance roles exist; governance authorization is still unresolved.
